data.title: Morning, at the gate
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Sorry to stop you so early. Our son was arrested on Saturday; it's a misunderstanding, but he's been charged. Speaker 2: Ezra, that's terrible. Is he all right? Speaker 1: He's home, but we need a good criminal defence lawyer, and you know people. Speaker 2: I'll send you the name of the lawyer who helped my colleague, today. Speaker 1: Thank you. We're not telling anyone on the street.
